items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: That was at the Club Harlem in 1934, with Bobby Booker's Orchestra... I started my career basically there with Bobby Booker's band.

ctx.x: Yeah, spin it. Wear a funny hat, you know. That was it. That was at the Club Harlem in 1934, with Bobby Booker's Orchestra -- (End of side 1 as recorded.)
We had a hell of an orchestra there. We stayed the whole season.
